main_text.p: tantùm ad arcanum Dei confilium sint referenda. Ideoquè hæc Calvinus clarè & apertè afferere audet, sinè obscuritate, sinè impietate, sinè falsitate, quia omnia secundùm scripturam tradita, ut ex superioribus intelligi poteft.
Post hæc omnia, sub finem huius paralleli adfert, ut ipse ait,
main_text.head: CATHOLICAM SOLUTIONEM argumenti Calviniftici.

p.i: Vel sum prædestinatus, vel sum reprobus: si primum, salvabor quicquid egero: si secundum, damnabor quicquid egero.

main_text.p: Hunc disputandi modum 1. vocat ineptum, quod simili ostendit de currente & comedente. Id deinde applicat prædestinationi & reprobationi. 2. negat, quòd homo salvari possit quicquid egerit, quia qui hominem

page.notes: The ornamental dingbat rows are printed fleurons, rendered approximately. The final word "nem" is a catchword-like continuation of the last line, printed at the right margin of the last line; treated as the continuation of "hominem". Some words in the lower lines are faint and uncertain, notably "ostendit" and "egerit".
